281265300.description:
Assorted Rough Gemstone Mineral Specimen Lot
Natural Unpolished Stones
20 Pieces Total
This collection features a diverse array of natural, rough gemstone and mineral specimens in their unpolished state. The lot includes a variety of geological materials, ranging from metallic pyrite clusters to crystalline clear quartz and vibrant blue sodalite. These pieces are ideal for lapidary work, crystal collections, or decorative displays, showcasing the raw beauty of natural mineral formations.
Includes approximately 20 distinct specimens of various colors and textures
Notable stones include metallic pyrite, blue sodalite, green fluorite, and rose quartz
Clear quartz crystal points and banded jasper specimens present in the lot
Individual specimen sizes range from approximately 0.5 to 1.5 inches
Condition:
Very good natural condition. These are raw, unpolished specimens as shown in photographs. Surfaces exhibit natural textures, inclusions, and fractures inherent to rough minerals. No synthetic treatments or dyes are visually apparent across the lot. Pyrite pieces show characteristic metallic luster and crystal habit.
